candidates.description: This vector activates for names of prominent historical philosophers, literary figures, and thinkers, often appearing as word fragments or full proper nouns.

This vector represents common Italian verb infinitives, suffixes, and rhyming morphological endings.
This vector is related to punctuation marks and closing quotation or bracket symbols combined with sentence-ending periods or commas.
Demonstrative pronouns and determiners across multiple European languages.

This feature vector activates strongly on the letter sequence "per" occurring as a prefix or subword unit across various roots and languages.
